summary: Egypt’s national Survey Authority and spatial-planning services were evidenced, but no anonymous first-party Girga cadastral parcel geometry service was verified. No sample GeoJSON was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Arabic discovery queries are recorded verbatim in city-7280-girga.json. Results were limited to official national mapping/survey, spatial-planning, public survey-service, and Girga tax-office pages.
requestOutcomes: All executed first-party checks and outcomes are recorded in city-7280-girga.json under requestsAndEndpointChecks. Direct ESA access encountered an expired certificate; TLS verification was not bypassed. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe field, or broad TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: The Survey Authority pages describe national map and land-survey products, not an open Girga parcel layer.
The Girga-specific ETA page is a tax-office administrative coverage page, not evidence of a cadastral registry or geometry API.
GOPP describes national spatial-planning basemap and urban-boundary integration, not parcel identities.
The PSM survey-statement page is a service workflow and returned 502 during direct fetch; it did not expose parcel geometry.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, certificate failure, or unavailable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence.

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified native parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Open parcel coverage, schema, CRS, native identity semantics, and citywide completeness remain unverified. National mapping capability is documented, but local open registry access and runtime integration are not admitted.
